  have A : IsUniformInducing (WithLp.equiv p (∀ i, β i)) :=
    (antilipschitzWith_equiv_aux p β).isUniformInducing
      (lipschitzWith_equiv_aux p β).uniformContinuous

  rw [← A.comap_uniformity, this, comap_id]

  | succ m =>
